definition.default_reference_rule: If no reference point is specified when houses are mentioned, it means that lagna is used as the reference
definition.order_wraps: when we encounter Pisces, we go to Aries after it
definition.text: Starting from the rasi occupied by the selected reference point and proceeding in the regular order across the zodiac, we associate each rasi with a house. Always the rasi containing the reference point chosen is the 1st house.

body.note: A house never spans two rasis. Section 7.5 rejects bhava chalit, equal-house and Sripathi division outright: 'Each rasi is a house.' That is why the engine's default house_system is whole_sign.

purusharthas.meaning: righteousness and adherence to one's duty
